productionChange: Preserve the verified paper resolution through in-fit sharing, polishing and progress snapshots; skip extra clearance grids after their refinement window expires; offer rejected detail and polish candidates the existing checked clamp correction before discarding them. Restoration also checks four quarters of each original feature pixel under the geometric tolerance. Regional sampling uses the identical full-render intersections on only the affected rows. Final acceptance thresholds are unchanged.

fidelity.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement. Small interior regions must also remain separate from the square boundary.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

limitations: 2/3 committed-code ten-second vertical-crop replays pass; repeated short-budget measurements do not establish reliable timing across hardware or runtime conditions.
Accuracy is measured against classified photographs, not unavailable original cutting paths.
The tested browser uses the ordinary longer allowance, not a ten-second timeout.
Wall-clock-limited trajectories and selected detail passes can change with runtime; all repeat outcomes are retained.
Synchronous validation cannot be preempted by the correction deadline.
No physical assembly was tested.
